project.title: Say the film
project.idea: Remake the reference (cevox__ motion reel, 15 s, 16:9, 17 shots) shot for shot in structure and rhythm, but about Émile: a Mac video editor built for AI — you say the film you want, and the AI makes it on a real multi-track timeline. Use the Émile brand: grounds #100f0e / #1b1917 with soft radial glows (radial-gradient(90% 70% at 50% 46%, #2d2823, #181513 48%, #100f0e)), cream text #f7f4ee, a single burnt-orange accent #d9541e (replaces the reference's red; use orange+cream+brown instead of its red/blue/yellow primaries), headlines in heavy italic Fraunces (weight 850, tight tracking), body in system sans; rounded cards (radius 12–14 px), pill shapes. Tone: short, direct, human. Structure following the reference: opening 0–3 s: a bouncing orange ball with squash & stretch and dotted trail on black, then on an orange ground a heavy italic headline slamming in word by word on the beat, e.g. "SAY IT. IT MOVES." Body 3–10.5 s: numbered chapters, ~1–1.5 s each, each showing one Émile idea as motion: a chat line being typed ("make me a launch film") morphing into shapes; clips dropping onto stacked tracks of a multi-track timeline; a playhead sweeping across; a circle drawn on a frame (circle it) and a clip being cut (cut it); filter looks swapping (halftone, risograph, VHS-like); cards flying in with a counter and bars growing. Fast section ~10.5–11.9 s: 7 tiny icon shots one per beat (~0.2 s): playhead, waveform, film strip, scissors, chat bubble, track stack, sparkle. Ending 11.9–15 s: a disc rushes across the cut and lands as the accent in the wordmark, which grows into an end card with the Émile logo (assets/brand/Émile/logo-dark.png, used as given, never redrawn), the italic Fraunces "Émile" wordmark, the line "Make films with your AI." and a small pill "Download for Mac". On-screen words in English. Do not copy the reference's words, logo or brand — only how it is built.

moments.show: Film black #100f0e ground with the faint brand glow. A thin cream wavy line (2 px) crosses the lower middle. An orange #d9541e ball, 90 px, drops from top-left: on beat 1 it hits the line and squashes flat (1.4× wide, 0.6× tall), stretches tall as it rebounds; on beat 2 a smaller bounce further right; on beat 3 a third; on beat 4 it rolls to rest at centre. Behind it a dotted trail of small cream dots marks its arc, each dot fading. Corner frame labels as the conventions say.

Full Ember orange #d9541e ground. Heavy italic Fraunces 850 in #1b1917, two lines centred: 'SAY IT.' / 'IT MOVES.' One word slams in per beat with a short motion-blur stretch and overshoot: beat 1 'SAY', beat 2 'IT.', beat 3 'IT', beat 4 'MOVES.' while the whole block pushes in 8%. Labels cream at 60%.

Cream #f7f4ee ground. Top-left '01' orange Fraunces italic and 'Say the film you want' in sans. Centre: a #1b1917 chat pill, radius 99 px, 900 px wide; on beat 1 'make me a launch film' types into it in cream sans 40 px with an orange caret. On beat 2 the pill collapses into one orange shape that morphs on each half-beat: circle, rounded square, triangle, star, with brown #8a5a3c and #2d2823 offset echoes and thin #1b1917 guide boxes around it; on beat 3 it ends as a rounded clip block.

clips.name: Clips drop onto tracks → The playhead sweeps

moments.show: Ember orange ground. Top-left '02' in cream Fraunces italic and 'On a real timeline' in sans. Centre: the three stacked #1b1917 tracks. An orange clip block drops in from the top and lands on track 1 on beat 1; on beat 2 two more clips (cream, brown) drop onto tracks 2 and 3 with a small squash; on beat 3 the stack tilts slightly and the orange clip springs off upward and out the right edge, carried into the next scene.

Dark glow ground. The orange clip arrives from the left and snaps into a 22 px disc atop a cream 4 px playhead line. Top-left '03' and 'Play it back'. Behind it a ring of small cream halftone dots around the centre. On beat 1 the playhead starts at the left; across beats 2–3 it sweeps right and the dots it passes swell into a crest, the ring rotating slowly; on beat 4 it stops at the right edge and the dots settle.

Dark panel #1b1917 ground. Top-left '04' and 'Circle it. Cut it.'. Centre a cream frame card (16:9, 720 px wide, radius 14) with a flat scene inside (an orange sun over a brown hill). Beat 1: an orange marker circle draws itself around the sun in one stroke. Beat 2: the card drops onto a single track as a clip; a cream cut line slashes through it and the two halves jump apart 40 px. Beat 3: they settle, the gap clean.

Cream ground. Top-left '05' and 'Pick a look'. Centre: the same sun-over-hill frame card; under it three pills: 'Halftone', 'Risograph', 'VHS'. A cursor clicks one pill per beat, the clicked pill turning orange with a burst of small ticks: beat 1 Halftone, the card becomes orange ink dots on cream; beat 2 Risograph, two brown and orange inks out of register; beat 3 VHS, colour bleeding sideways with a torn bottom edge. The three looks are drawn in code on the card only.

Cream ground. Top-left '06' and 'Render'. On beat 1 three rounded cards fly in from the sides and lock into a row: an orange card counting 0 to 100% in Fraunces italic with 'Rendering' under it, a #1b1917 card with five cream bars growing, a cream card with a brown line drawing on. On beat 2 the counter hits 100% and the bars land.

clips.name: Seven icons, one per beat → End card: Download for Mac

moments.show: Seven tiny full-frame icon shots, hard cuts on every half-beat (0.2 s each, the seventh 0.4 s), each icon 360 px, flat, centred, popping in from 0.6×: 1 cream ground, #1b1917 playhead with an orange disc nudging right; 2 orange ground, cream waveform of nine rounded bars bouncing; 3 dark glow ground, cream film strip sliding left with one orange frame; 4 cream ground, #1b1917 scissors with orange handles snapping shut; 5 mid brown #8a5a3c ground, cream chat bubble with three orange dots pulsing; 6 orange ground, three #1b1917 track bars stacking down; 7 dark panel ground, a cream four-point sparkle bursts open, then on the last half-beat the orange disc shoots out of it and whips right with cream speed lines and a stretch, leaving across the cut.

Dark glow ground. The orange disc enters from the left still stretched, slows, and on beat 1 drops onto the cream italic Fraunces 'Emile' (300 px, centred) as the accent of the É: it squashes once and morphs into an orange acute stroke. On beat 2 the letters jolt and begin to shrink and rise toward the end card's position.

Dark glow ground with a soft orange halo (radial-gradient(circle, rgba(217,84,30,0.3), transparent 52%)) behind the centre. The wordmark settles at 150 px, cream with its orange accent, with the logo image assets/brand/Émile/logo-dark.png (180 px) to its left. Beat 1: under it, 'Make films with your AI.' in Fraunces 850 italic 72 px cream lands word by word. Beat 2: a small orange pill 'Download for Mac' (Fraunces 800, 28 px, white text, radius 99) pops in below with a small bounce; a cursor glides to it and presses it on beat 4, the pill dipping 2 px. Beats 5–6 hold.

cues.words: 片尾标语最后一个词 'AI.' 落定：音乐停在这里，一声重音余响托住片尾卡
